get.description: Returns process health and a lightweight database connectivity check.

post.description: Authenticates a field user and returns an access and refresh token pair.
post.summary: Sign in with staff ID and PIN

post.description: Authenticates an operations, quality, admin, or GBfoods reviewer user and returns tokens.
post.summary: Sign in with email and password

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access and refresh token pair.
Revokes the refresh token session when it is still valid.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user profile for the bearer access token.
Returns KPIs and per-depot status for GBfoods reviewers: completion, review queues, holds, and sync delays for a calendar day.

parameters.name: reviewStatus
parameters.description: Filter depot rows by GBfoods review status

get.description: Downloads reconciliation lines by depot, SKU, and batch for the selected day and optional region filter.
Downloads held-or-rejected lots with custodian and latest disposition for the selected day and optional region.
Returns reconciliation snapshots, stock lots, and hold log for one depot on a calendar day (CSV-friendly JSON).
Lists depot visits for operations and field users within assignment scope.
Derived stock balance by SKU and batch, held-lot custodian gaps, signatures, and close readiness.

post.description: Captures QC, cluster supervisor, or depot representative sign-off with optional drawn signature image.
Completes reconciliation when balanced and signed, or closes as exception with open actions.
Returns a presigned PUT URL for attendance, stock evidence, escalation photos, or signatures when R2 is configured.
Writes the file to apps/api/.uploads when R2 is not configured. Returns objectKey local/…
Alternative local upload using raw body and Content-Type header.

get.description: Redirects to R2 public URL or streams a local dev file by objectKey.
Returns clusters ordered by name, optionally filtered by region.

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: Only clusters in this region cuid

get.description: Returns Ghana network regions ordered by name for ops and field users.
Returns distributors for the network register, optionally filtered by region id.

post.description: Creates a distributor under a region for national operations or admin users.

patch.description: Updates distributor contact details, cluster link, or active flag.

get.description: Returns depot register entries, optionally filtered by distributor or region id.

post.description: Creates a depot under a distributor with address and optional recce pin coordinates.

get.description: Returns a single depot including optional recce coordinates.

patch.description: Updates depot address, contacts, readiness, or recce coordinates.

get.description: Returns active depots within the user's assignment scope for field check-in.
Returns user network assignments with scope and effective dates, optionally filtered by user.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Only assignments for this user cuid

post.description: Assigns a field user (typically QC) to a distributor, cluster, or region scope.

patch.description: Sets the effective end date of an assignment (defaults to now), which removes the scope from the user's depot list once the date has passed.

post.description: Stores attendance with photo object key and optional GPS coordinates. Missing GPS is allowed.

get.description: Supervisors and ops can list attendance for a calendar date with optional filters.
Returns the signed-in field user's attendance events for the current UTC day.
Returns active product SKUs for stock capture and ops.

post.description: Creates a product SKU. Restricted to admin and national ops.
Creates a stock lot with evidence for a visit or today's visit at an assigned depot.

get.description: Lists stock lots filtered by visit, depot, and/or calendar date.
Returns a single stock lot with SKU, evidence, and visit context.

post.description: GBfoods reviewer records release, hold, reject, or repack approval; updates lot zone and appends a disposition movement.

patch.description: Field or supervisor assigns custodian name for held or rejected stock lots.

get.description: Lists depot recces with gaps and evidence, newest first, optionally filtered by depot or decision.

post.description: Records a depot recce with checklist, gaps, and optional photo keys. A critical gap forces a hold decision. The depot readiness is synced to the latest recce decision.

get.description: Returns a single recce with checklist, gaps, evidence, depot, and author.

patch.description: Updates checklist, decision, notes, or replaces gaps and evidence. A critical gap still forces a hold decision. The depot readiness is re-synced to its latest recce.

get.description: Lists the latest training assessment per user with a dispatchable flag. Filter by user or pass/fail result. Set history=true to list every assessment.

parameters.name: history
parameters.description: Return every assessment instead of only the latest per user

post.description: Records a safety, quality, and record-keeping assessment for a field user. All three must pass for a pass result and dispatch eligibility; otherwise the result is fail. Each submission becomes the user's latest assessment.

get.description: Returns a single assessment with the assessed user and assessor.
Lists regional daily returns, newest first, optionally filtered by region and by a single day.

post.description: Submits the daily return for a region and date. If one already exists for that region and date it is updated instead (upsert). Depot counts not supplied are derived from active depots and that day's visits in the region.

get.description: Aggregates the regional daily returns for a day: how many active regions have submitted, national depot totals, and a per-region breakdown including regions still outstanding.
Returns a single regional daily return with region and submitter.

patch.description: Updates summaries or depot counts on an existing daily return. Region and date cannot change.

get.description: Lists field exceptions raised as escalations, newest first, optionally filtered by depot, visit, and status.

post.description: Records a field exception with a trigger, note, and photos. The visit status is not changed, so the field can still reconcile.

get.description: Returns a single escalation with depot, reporter, and photo evidence.

patch.description: Updates status, owner, due date, or written record. Moving to resolved stamps the resolution time; moving back clears it.

get.description: Lists users for ops screens, optionally filtered by role, active flag, or a search term on name, staff ID, or email. Omit isActive to include inactive users. Returns no credentials.

parameters.name: isActive
parameters.description: Filter by active flag. Omit to return active and inactive users.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search on name, staff ID, or email

post.description: Creates a user. Field roles (qc, handler, cluster_supervisor, regional_supervisor) need a staff ID and PIN. Desk roles (admin, national_ops, national_quality, gbfoods_reviewer) need an email and password.

get.description: Returns a single user profile. Never includes PIN or password hashes.

patch.description: Updates profile fields or the active flag. Send pin or password to reset credentials; resetting a PIN also clears the lock. Deactivating or resetting credentials signs the user out of existing sessions.

info.title: GBfoods Stock Control API
info.description: Field and client API for the GBfoods nationwide depot sorting and segregation programme.

staffId.description: Staff ID printed on the field photo ID card

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token returned at sign-in

imageObjectKey.description: Drawn signature image object key from uploads

openActions.description: When provided, closes the visit as exception with tracked open actions

effectiveTo.description: End date for the assignment. Defaults to now when omitted.

accuracyMeters.description: GPS accuracy in meters when available

depotId.description: Depot id; resolves or creates today's visit for the current user

reason.example: Meets release criteria after QC review

access.description: Vehicle and staff access is safe and workable

stockEstimateNote.example: About 400 cases, mostly Gino tomato mix

holdingZones.description: Holding zones can be set up

description.example: Loading bay gate is locked after 17:00

isCritical.description: A critical access or safety gap blocks a ready decision

evidenceKeys.description: R2 object keys of optional recce photos; capture time is stamped by the API

gaps.description: When provided, replaces all existing gaps

evidenceKeys.description: When provided, replaces evidence; existing keys keep their capture time

userId.description: Field user being assessed (qc, handler, or cluster_supervisor)

coverageSummary.description: Depot coverage summary for the day

stockStatusSummary.description: Stock status summary for the day

depotsPlanned.description: Defaults to the active depots in the region

depotsCompleted.description: Defaults to complete visits in the region that day

depotsException.description: Defaults to exception visits in the region that day

depotId.description: Depot the exception was found at

visitId.description: Visit the exception belongs to, when known

note.description: What happened, in the reporter's words

evidenceKeys.description: Object keys of uploaded photos; capture time is stamped by the API

ownerName.description: Owner of the follow-up. An empty string clears it.

writtenRecord.description: Written record of the resolution or decision

hasPin.description: True when a field PIN has been set

hasPassword.description: True when a desk password has been set

pin.description: Four to six digits. Required for field roles

password.description: At least 8 characters. Required for desk roles

staffId.description: Field roles only; cannot be cleared

email.description: Desk roles only; cannot be cleared

phone.description: Send an empty string to clear the phone number

pin.description: Resets the field PIN, clears the lock and failed attempts

password.description: Resets the desk password (at least 8 characters)
